# Changelog

Every release of `@bowmark/web` (npm) and `bowmark-web` / `bowmark-web-stubs` (PyPI).
The three always ship at one version. They are one client in two languages, plus its stubs.

Entries are generated from the list of covered websites and their functions, so this
file describes the callable surface and nothing else. Each release names every website
it added, changed or removed.
